name: ask-sales-v5-7-final-promotion-gate-preregistration-2026-07-27

eligible: A real sales-rep question with a readable, authoritative threaded answer
The answer is attributable to Rich, Mike, Rudy, Raul, or Madeline
The question is realistic for the passive Ask Sales chatbot
The source thread is self-contained enough to create an auditable answer label
Every source message ID has zero overlap with all prior Ask Sales evaluation datasets and runtime artifacts
excluded: Screenshot-only, attachment-only, missing-context, joke, announcement, or malformed questions
Pure requests for a human to perform an action unless intentionally selected as a routing control
Questions whose source answer depends on unavailable private context
Threads with unresolved material disagreement after checking the complete frozen authority state
Any question or source used to design or tune V5.7
selectionProtocol.authorityReview: Gold labels must be checked against the complete frozen knowledge state. Rich normally outranks Madeline for Sales policy, but recency, scope, and whether the statements govern the exact same decision must be evaluated together.
selectionProtocol.selectionOrder: Select for quality and coverage before any V3 or V5.7 runtime is executed. Runtime output must never influence inclusion, exclusion, wording, or gold labels.

coverageTargets: pricing, packages, discounts, or payment boundaries
eligibility, business fit, content, or show scope
Call 1, Call 2, no-show, cohort, reapply, or scheduling procedure
contracts, rights, testimonials, onboarding, filming, editing, or distribution
Finance, Green Light, Fulfillment, Sales Tech, Slack access, or other action ownership
unsupported, irrelevant, live-status, or passive-chatbot control
